# Swiss Watch Company

> > Premium Swiss watch retailer in India featuring authentic Aerowatch, Atlantic, Herbelin, and Milus timepieces with Swiss Made movements.

Swiss Watch Company specializes in importing and retailing authentic Swiss luxury watches in India, with a focus on brands like Aerowatch, Michel Herbelin, and Milus. The company offers comprehensive collections for men, women, and unisex styles, featuring both quartz and mechanical movements with warranty coverage and customer support based in Bangalore.
